children: Trade granted a performance-based stock option to Chief Executive Officer Jeff Green, enabling him to purchase up to 7,000,000 Class A shares if specified stock-price targets are met.
To create a long-term, stockholder-aligned incentive and further align CEO interests with stockholders
Grant approved by Compensation Committee and Board; Mr. Green recused from the vote

Up to 7,000,000 shares; exercise price $14.97; seven vesting tranches tied to 20-consecutive-trading-day average price targets from $18.00 to $105.00; ten-year term; vesting subject to continued service and other conditions
